name: transcript
description: Clean and reconstruct noisy meeting transcripts into publication-ready conversational prose with strict fidelity validation.

interface.longDescription: Transcript reconstructs interrupted conversation into publication-ready prose, improves grammar and flow, removes verbal noise, preserves every substantive turn, voice, and chronology, validates coverage against the source, and marks uncertain wording inline.
defaultPrompt: Clean this transcript into publication-ready conversational prose without summarizing. Preserve every substantive turn, idea, voice, and chronology, apply confirmed contextual resolutions, validate fidelity against the source, and mark remaining uncertain passages inline.
